revision_summary: No fabricated/failed quotes were found (deterministic check returned empty and manual spot-checks confirm quotes are accurate). However, revisions are needed on five points: (1) starting_state should acknowledge the pre-21-second identity confusion (00:00-00:12) rather than treating 00:21 as the call's true opening moment. (2) The 04:36 credit-qualifier moment is mislabeled 'protocol_violation' — reclassify as a verify/qualifier-precision gap since multi-owner credit ambiguity isn't a defined protocol in the schema (protocols section covers spouse/adult-child/time/hello-objection/how-did-you-get-my-number only). (3) The bill_anchor_audit marks bill_captured:true on a secondhand, admittedly-about-a-different-bill $140 estimate — this should be flagged as low-confidence/unverified rather than a clean capture, since coaching a 'flip' on a wrong number is risky. (4) The 05:32 empathy_miss classification should be softened to 'needs audio review' given Stage 3's own admission that speaker attribution is ambiguous — a directive coaching_implication shouldn't ride on an unconfirmed attribution. (5) The handoff_brief should explicitly note the third co-owner (the 'other sister' mentioned at 00:36) who is never followed up on at all, in addition to Ernest — currently only Ernest's absence is flagged as an unresolved concern. The outcome dispute (reclassifying to 'callback' with no day/time) is well-supported and should be kept as-is.
